parrafo_1.es: Cuervo Home Solutions es un equipo familiar de handyman y remodelación con base en St. Petersburg. Karen y Luc, junto a su equipo, se encargan desde reparaciones pequeñas hasta construcciones completas en el patio, tratando cada casa como si fuera la suya.
parrafo_1.en: Cuervo Home Solutions is a family-run handyman and remodeling team based in St. Petersburg. Karen and Luc, along with their crew, handle everything from small repairs to full backyard builds, treating every house like it is their own.

parrafo_2.es: Los vecinos siguen llamándolos para proyectos nuevos porque el trabajo dura y el precio se mantiene justo. Cada foto de este sitio es de un trabajo que ellos mismos hicieron, sin fotos de stock.
parrafo_2.en: Neighbors keep calling them back for new projects because the work holds up and the price stays fair. Every photo on this site is from a job they actually built, no stock photos.

texto.es: Cuéntanos qué pasa en tu casa. Karen o Luc responden directamente, sin call center ni formularios.
texto.en: Tell us what is going on at your place. Karen or Luc answer directly, no call center and no forms.

texto.es: Revisamos el proyecto (en persona o con fotos y video) y te damos un precio claro antes de empezar.
texto.en: We take a look, in person or from photos and video, and give you a clear, honest price before any work starts.

texto.es: Cercas, decks, pintura, reparaciones: llegamos cuando dijimos y usamos materiales pensados para el clima de Florida.
texto.en: Fencing, decks, painting, repairs, whatever the project, we show up on schedule and use materials built for Florida weather.

texto.es: Recorremos el trabajo contigo antes de darlo por terminado, para que no haya sorpresas despues.
texto.en: We walk the finished job with you before we call it done, so there are no surprises after we leave.

nota.es: Cada proyecto se cotiza según el alcance y los materiales: no hay dos casas iguales. Llámanos o escríbenos para un presupuesto gratis.
nota.en: Every project is quoted based on scope and materials, no two houses are the same. Call or text us for a free estimate.

texto.es: Puertas de closet, arreglos de iluminación, montaje de TV, plomería menor y todos esos pendientes que se acumulan en casa.
texto.en: Closet doors, lighting fixes, TV mounting, minor plumbing, and the odd jobs that pile up around the house.

texto.es: Decks de madera a medida, pérgolas de cedro y cercas o portones de madera y metal, construidos para aguantar el clima de Florida.
texto.en: Custom wood decks, cedar pergolas, and wood or metal fencing and gates, built to hold up to Florida weather.

texto.es: Desde proyectos de remodelación completos hasta pintar puertas, gabinetes y zócalos, con atención real al detalle.
texto.en: From full renovation projects to painting doors, cabinets and baseboards, finished with real attention to detail.

texto.es: Instalación de luces navideñas, arreglos de jardín y limpieza, incluida limpieza de cambio de huéspedes para alquileres a corto plazo.
texto.en: Holiday light installation, landscaping touch-ups and cleaning, including turnover cleaning for short-term rentals.

items.quote: I am so happy to find a home maintenance company that does great work at an affordable price. I highly recommend Cuervo Home Solutions. They installed closet doors, fixed a lighting issue, mounted a wall TV and took care of a plumbing problem.

I highly recommend Cuervo Home Solutions for your handyman, home repairs and renovation projects. They perform very high quality work at very reasonable prices. They use high quality materials that will last in our Florida weather.

I've had Karen and Luc help with several odd jobs around the house including painting my door and cabinets. They are both responsive, friendly, and they always make sure that I'm satisfied with the result. I highly recommend CHS!
